summary_markdown:
The discussion covered the status of sensor deployment, noting that one sensor was connected in the Netherlands and a Jetson device was also connected. There were concerns raised regarding the display of 3G connectivity at multiple locations (e.g., Belgium), with participants questioning the source and reliability of this signal.

One participant plans to visit later to check the Lidar system version update for the Dubai location.
decisions: Investigate the source and stability of 3G connectivity signals at various sites.
action_items: [p1] will check and potentially update the Lidar system version in Dubai later.
